topic: Sun’s Movement, Shadows, and Importance of the Sun
key_concepts: The Sun appears to move across the sky during the day
The Sun’s daily motion across the sky is an apparent motion
Earth’s rotation causes the Sun’s apparent movement
Galileo used sunspot observations as evidence that the Sun rotates
Different parts of the Sun rotate at different rates
A shadow forms when an object blocks sunlight
Shadow length and direction change throughout the day
The Sun provides light and heat to Earth
Sunlight and warmth are important to animals and humans
